Tata Sons faces boardroom dispute, plans AGM within a month

Tata Sons is embroiled in a boardroom dispute over the scope of the chairman’s casting vote. The parties have indicated that a mutual settlement is preferred to lengthy litigation that could create leadership uncertainty. The company has said it will convene its annual general meeting within a month and may approach the National Company Law Tribunal for directions to hold the meeting.
